sample_unit: standardised vignettes (paired AI and specialist prescriptions)

links.outcome: Inter-rater reliability of blinded reviewer scoring across safety domains
links.effect: Total-score ICC 0.47; slight agreement for contraindication and interaction recognition (weighted κ 0.11 and 0.08), indicating low reproducibility of safety-domain scoring.
links.quote: The total-score intraclass correlation coefficient was 0.47, with slight agreement for contraindication and interaction recognition (κ 0.11 and 0.08).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM (Claude) autonomous prescribing on simulated clinical vignettes compared to specialist prescribing, assessing safety and accuracy without testing a specific organizational deployment practice.
